title: A finite swept contact surface replaces an arbitrary cam height curve
statement: Producer surface screens reject10/20deg transitions for undercut and30deg for inner folding;38deg transition plus2deg dwell is feasible in its executed screen. Rounded acceleration improves inner curvature and stays in the commanded curvature square. Two independently rotating opposed rollers are needed: one roller cannot roll on both moving faces without slip. Finite radial width still has differential circumferential velocity; corrected geometry does not receive frictionless contact.
